nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Mintlify starter-kit README for the docs package, covering local preview via the `mint` CLI, GitHub-app-driven publishing to production, and troubleshooting; still largely carries upstream Mintlify template content rather than opencode-specific material.

nodes.name: development.mdx
nodes.summary: Mintlify development guide for the opencode SDK docs site: installing the `mint` CLI, running local previews with custom ports, validating broken links, deployment verification, MDX code formatting, and troubleshooting accordion items.

nodes.name: docs.json
nodes.summary: Mintlify site configuration for `@opencode-ai/docs`, defining the green brand colors, logo/favicon, navbar, contextual AI options, and the SDK tab navigation that registers the index, quickstart, and development pages plus an OpenAPI-powered API reference (backed by the local `openapi.json` published at opencode.ai).
nodes.languageNotes: The navigation group's `openapi` key makes Mintlify auto-generate the API reference section from the published spec, separate from hand-written MDX pages.

nodes.name: index.mdx
nodes.summary: Landing page of the Mintlify docs site, presenting card layouts that route readers to the quickstart, local development, site customization, and OpenAPI-generated API reference sections.

nodes.name: quickstart.mdx
nodes.summary: Three-step Mintlify quickstart for the docs site: clone the docs repo and start `mint dev`, deploy through the Mintlify GitHub app while making a first branding edit to `docs.json`, then publish by pushing to the default branch.
